title: Delayed Burial
description: A strange jester named Cicero is stranded near Loreius Farm with a broken wagon wheel. The player must choose between helping Cicero convince farmer Vantus Loreius to repair the wheel, or siding with Loreius by reporting Cicero to the guard.

base_facts: I am a jester from Cyrodiil transporting my mother's remains to a new home in Skyrim.
My wagon wheel has broken and the farmer Loreius refuses to help me fix it.
I just want to be on my way and leave this place behind.

CICERO_REQUEST: A kind stranger has agreed to speak with Loreius on my behalf.
HELPED_CICERO: Loreius has agreed to fix my wheel! I am deeply grateful to my new friend.
BETRAYED_CICERO: The stranger reported me to the guard. Loreius will suffer for this betrayal.

base_facts: I own Loreius Farm on the road north of Whiterun.
That mad jester Cicero won't stop pestering me to fix his broken wagon wheel.
I suspect his coffin contains skooma or other illegal cargo and I want no part of it.

CHOICE_MADE: Someone has offered to help resolve this situation with the jester.
HELPED_CICERO: Fine, I will fix the fool's wheel if it means he finally leaves my farm.
BETRAYED_CICERO: The guard will deal with Cicero. Good riddance to that lunatic.

beats.comment: Player discovers the stranded jester on the road near Loreius Farm.
Cicero explains his situation and asks the player to convince Loreius to help.
Player has spoken to Loreius and must choose to help Cicero or turn him in.
Player persuaded Loreius to fix the wheel. Must report back to Cicero.
Player reported Cicero to the guard. Must notify Loreius.
The conflict between Cicero and Loreius has been resolved, one way or another.
